create_artifact_table: create a SQLite table schema for storing document artifacts including tables, text, and images
query_document_artifacts: query the document artifacts SQLite database and return results as a pandas DataFrame
export_db_to_csv: export the document artifacts table from SQLite to a CSV file
write_to_vector_index: write document contents to a ChromaDB vector index for semantic search
knn_query_vector_index: perform a semantic search query on the ChromaDB vector index and return results
